constraints: RULED BEHAVIOUR CHANGE. Record Ruling D21 in the notebook BEFORE implementing it; the ruling must precede the code in the commit order.

RULING D21, COMMITTED VERBATIM: 'Ruling D21 — recovery must carry the failure forward or not exist. ARCH-20260923-054 established that recovery_loop re-runs the implement node with no dissent, no unmet criteria and no escalation diagnosis as input: it is a retry, not a mechanism. A retry that supplies no new information cannot convert a failure that feedback would have fixed, and it costs three implement iterations on every recoverable failure. When the implement phase runs inside recovery_loop it must receive the previous iteration unmet criteria (coverage.missed) and the escalation resolution_directive as input. This is a behaviour change and it is ruled here. If it cannot be done without altering what the harness concludes elsewhere, stop and report rather than widening it.'

FIRST, VERIFY THE PREMISE against the code, not against the commit message: read the recovery_loop body and the implement phase's input assembly and quote what the implement phase actually receives on a recovery iteration. If it already receives the unmet criteria, the premise is wrong — say so and return NO_ACTION with the evidence.

THE MINIMAL CHANGE: on a recovery iteration only, pass coverage.missed and escalation.resolution_directive (or root_cause_analysis if no directive exists) into the implement phase's context. Do not change the build_loop's first iteration — it has no prior failure to carry.
Do NOT change verdict semantics, gate routing, loop exit conditions, thresholds or bounds. Only what the implement phase is told, on recovery iterations.

Do NOT change review_rework_loop's implement input. That loop responds to a blocked review, which already supplies its own findings; state whether the same plumbing could serve both and do not change it without a ruling.

EXTEND THE -054 HARNESS: its fourth case must now assert that the recovery attempt RECEIVED the unmet criteria — quote what the recovery implement call was passed. A test that asserts only that the run completed does not test this ruling.
Prove it by breaking it: remove the plumbing and show the assertion fail.
Report what fraction of a recoverable failure's cost the three recovery iterations represent, from the -051 case (c) numbers. State it as a measured proportion, not an estimate.
Keep the diff small. Suite reported before and after.
